s1.text:
New things that need your OK (not in the live app today):

1. "Search this area" button, shown after you drag the map
2. "Nearest" tile next to "Best offer"
3. Poster's star rating on the job card
4. How-far picker (5 / 10 / 25 km) inside the map

Kept: every old feature. Best-paying areas is now a tab next to Jobs. Helpers mode gets the same panel and sheet.

All names, prices and areas here are sample data.
